opening.argument: The title and description identify a named song and present it as an official music video: “Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Video)” and “Rick Astley's official music video for “Never Gonna Give You Up”.” The description also directs viewers to listen to the artist, while the repeated romantic lyrics, “Never gonna give you up Never gonna let you down Never gonna run around and desert you,” and staged scenes of a performer singing into a microphone support a musical performance purpose. Nothing described shows a financial or data request, or a mechanism for obtaining money or information.
